components.name: Primary Hero Button
components.description: Squared high-contrast action used over hero photography.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--white); border-radius: 0; background: var(--white); color: var(--ink); font: 800 .85rem Arial, sans-serif; transition: background 180ms ease, color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent); color: var(--white); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Technical Text Link
components.description: Bold text action with a compact directional cue.
components.css: .ds-text-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink); font: 800 .85rem Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-text-link span { transition: transform 180ms ease; } .ds-text-link:hover span { transform: translate(2px, -2px); } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Squared technology filter with a decisive inverted selected state.
components.css: .ds-filter-chip { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 700 .74rem Arial, sans-serif; transition: background 180ms ease, color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-filter-chip:hover, .ds-filter-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--ink); background: var(--ink); color: var(--white); } .ds-filter-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Underline Search Field
components.description: Transparent search input grounded by one structural rule.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 9px; color: var(--muted); font: 700 .72rem Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 1rem Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Evidence Project Card
components.description: Flat project surface where media and measured outcomes carry the hierarchy.
components.html:
FPGA COMPUTER VISION

REAL-TIME VISION ACCELERATOR

81,380 frames/s · 5.739× OpenCV
components.css: .ds-project-card { display: grid; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); overflow: hidden; } .ds-project-media { aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; background: var(--dark); } .ds-project-copy { display: grid; gap: 11px; padding: 26px; } .ds-project-copy span { color: var(--accent); font: 700 .68rem 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .05em; } .ds-project-copy h3, .ds-project-copy p { margin: 0; } .ds-project-copy h3 { font: 800 1.6rem/1.05 Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.04em; } .ds-project-copy p { color: var(--muted); font: .78rem 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; } .ds-project-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Projects Navigation Signal
components.description: The only filled navigation action, used to make the work collection immediately reachable.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 30px; font: 700 .84rem Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:first-child { padding: 10px 16px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--white); box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(231,100,58,.24); } .ds-nav a:hover { opacity: .6; } .ds-nav a:first-child:hover { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Current-Work Ribbon
components.description: Narrow status band that repeats the active FPGA build without competing with project evidence.
components.html: COMING SOONARTY A7 / FPGA OPTICAL DSP
components.css: .ds-ticker { min-height: 42px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 28px; padding: 0 24px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--white); font: 700 .68rem 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .04em; } .ds-ticker i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border: 1px solid currentColor; transform: rotate(45deg); }

narrative.overview: The portfolio combines the clarity of engineering field notes with the quiet situational awareness of a control room. Real photographs, implementation screenshots, diagrams, measurements, and technical labels are the visual authority. The interface frames that evidence with a warm editorial canvas, firm typographic hierarchy, squared controls, and compact mono metadata. The system should feel precise and confident while retaining the physical, experimental character of student engineering work.
keyCharacteristics: Evidence-led imagery and measurable project outcomes.
Large editorial headlines paired with compact mono annotations.
Warm paper neutrals, carbon text, and one controlled orange signal.
Flat, rule-based structure with tactile interaction feedback.
Dense enough to communicate technical range without becoming dashboard-like.

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Burnt Signal Orange marks state, category, or action; it does not become a decorative background except for the narrow current-work ribbon.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: Use the established warm neutrals instead of pure white, blue-gray, or generic dashboard surfaces.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Sans-serif carries narrative and hierarchy; mono carries evidence and instrumentation. Do not set paragraphs or major headlines in mono.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Static content remains flat; shadows appear only when an element is genuinely layered or actively prioritized.

dos: Do lead with real project media, implementation screenshots, and measured outcomes.
Do use thin rules, grid alignment, and warm tonal shifts to organize information.
Do keep system labels short, uppercase, and mono while narrative copy stays in sans-serif.
Do make hover, focus, active, and modal states decisive and accessible.
Do preserve the honest status of unfinished work.
donts: Don't turn the site into a generic SaaS landing page with rounded card stacks, gradients, or feature-pill clutter.
Don't imitate cyberpunk dashboards with glowing telemetry, faux terminals, scan lines, or decorative HUD overlays.
Don't reduce the portfolio to a sparse résumé template that hides project artifacts and technical evidence.
Don't use Burnt Signal Orange as ambient decoration or flood large content surfaces with it.
Don't add promotional claims, fabricated metrics, or visual treatments that imply unfinished work is complete.
